summary: BBVA filed a 6-K disclosing execution of the First Tranche of its share buyback program, approved by the board on 2026-07-29 and initially announced as inside information on 2026-07-30 (CNMV registration 3316). HSBC Continental Europe acts as tranche manager; purchases ran from 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-30. Cumulative cash deployed totals EUR 937,716,638.05, roughly 93.77% of the First Tranche's maximum cash amount, under EU MAR Article 5 buyback rules. The disclosure is Spanish-market equivalent to a US issuer repurchase update under Rule 10b-18. Watch for completion of the tranche, any second tranche authorization, and BBVA's ongoing CET1 capital accretion trajectory.
